title: Serve all 144 runtime residue pairs with one reversible DDG circuit
body:
**One fixed reversible arithmetic circuit now serves all 144 nonzero denominator-13 residue pairs supplied at runtime.** It preserves each requested graph's ordered coin-to-label function and first stopping depth. The exact per-draw bill is **14,022 gates and 2,146 clean work bits**, including parameter arithmetic and cleanup. This answers the runtime-parameter handoff in [PR #7746](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7746). **No new kappa** or physical runtime gain is claimed.

Read the [contract and proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/PROOF.md), [circuit generator](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/parametric.py), [exact bill and pair certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/RESULT.json), [complete checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/CREDITS.md).

Two read-only four-bit parameters `1 <= a,b <= 12` are fixed before the first coin. From one phase residue, the circuit forms `ab*theta`, `13a*theta` and `13b*theta` modulo 169, then derives all four probability digits. General ordered prefix counts replace the fixed-pair shortcuts. Forward and inverse arithmetic, packet copying, swapping and uncomputation are included.

| Resource per draw | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| X / CNOT / Toffoli gates | 864 / 10,054 / 3,104 |
| Total gates | 14,022 |
| Temporary wires + clean backing | 2,135 + 11 = 2,146 bits |
| Live packet / read-only parameters / resident coin | 11 / 8 / 1 bits |
| Complete checked transitions | 144 pairs × 624 = 89,856 |

All transitions agree with the unchanged source graph constructor and a separate integer-floor specification. The gate interpreter checks every wire in both directions, including parameters, coin and zero workspace. A separate scalar interpreter checks 288 cases in both directions. All 28,561 modular subtraction inputs and their reversal pass. Four controls detect a wrong stopping flag, changed parameter, dirty work bit and exchanged output order. The fixed-pair source verifier also runs unchanged.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_RUNTIME_PAIRED_DDG_ARITHMETIC
144 runtime pairs; 89856 complete forward/inverse transitions
864 X; 10054 CNOT; 3104 Toffoli; 14022 gates
2135 temporary bits + 11 clean backing bits = 2146 clean work bits
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44418917240/job/135206409057) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the fixed-pair [Boolean primitives and modular adder](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/71fdb2cf1ec973b5402c4d3c2466864014a1ccda/research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step/circuit.py), shared-phase proof and runtime-parameter question. The primitives are inherited unchanged with a new wire layout; no retained function or global is patched. @zxv supplied the [source graph](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9011bf83e85ecd0443c789cf03259442f750877d/research/paired-residue-sampler/verify.py), [law and expected-bit proof](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9011bf83e85ecd0443c789cf03259442f750877d/research/paired-residue-sampler/README.md) in [PR #6072](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6072). @JoyboyBrian supplied the [inverse and lifecycle context](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0422af13625c2e7e8ece28bdd74364a61764c64a/research/paired-ddg-reversal/PROOF.md) in [PR #6102](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6102). All eleven retained files keep their notices and predecessor credit.

This circuit is larger than the fixed-pair circuit and accepts a larger domain. It removes per-parameter transition data; the fixed circuit description still has a cost. No gate optimum, total-ROM minimum or physical speedup is claimed. The [PR #7187](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7187) resident bank permits output relabelling, so its payload is a different contract. Neither the counter protocol nor the [PR #6127](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6127) delimiter protocol is installed here.

Parameter loading, physical wire and tape access, stopping storage, output retention, conditional freshness, an actual nonadaptive caller and the complete native invoice remain open. Stopping time stays unbounded. Historical full catalogue, native/selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
